name: Latent Diffusion Playground
postCreateCommand: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && uv sync --extra gui --extra train && uv run python scripts/download_checkpoints.py || true
postStartCommand: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && nohup uv run streamlit run scripts/web_demo.py --server.headless true --server.port 8501 > /tmp/streamlit.log 2>&1 &
